title: Chapter 662 - 662 Killing In One Move; Heated Discussion!
content:
Chapter 662 - 662 Killing In One Move; Heated Discussion!

Chapter 662 - 662 Killing in One Move; Heated Discussion!

662 Killing in One Move; Heated Discussion!

The voice was not loud.

However, it overshadowed the roaring beast tide and seemed to cause a ripple in the world.

Holy, ethereal!

It made people feel like they should get down on their knees and worship the speaker.

In the next moment…

The pitch-black night sky suddenly seemed to split open, and lightning crazily poured down like rain.

It was as if the entire world had welcomed daylight in an instant.

It was incomparably dazzling.

The world shook violently. Sand and stones flew everywhere!

The soldiers with special abilities had no choice but to cover their eyes with their hands.

After a long time, the thunder stopped and the white light dissipated. Only then did everyone slowly open their eyes.

In the next moment…

All the warriors with special abilities were stunned.

That was because the hundreds of thousands of exotic beasts nearby had all disappeared without a trace.

In their place… were only wisps of black dust and slowly dancing electric arcs.

The beast tide was instantly resolved!

They were all dead!

This… This was too unbelievable!

…

The scene was transmitted to the Xia Alliance’s headquarters.

Hu Yixiao said in surprise,” Just now… What happened?”

Liu Qi did not answer immediately. His hands were jumping on the keyboard.

Instantly, the scene that had been slowed down by 100 times appeared on the screen.

Liu Qi and Xue Zhan both frowned.

Hu Yixiao cried out in surprise again, “Why did so many lightning bolts suddenly descend?”

“Also, there’s no lack of B-class, A-class, and even some S-class exotic beasts in this beast tide. Lightning shouldn’t be able to cause too much damage to them.”

“What’s going on?!”

Hu Yixiao was one of the chiefs of Xia Alliance.

He was not as steady as Liu Qi, nor was he as silent as Xue Zhan.

However, with his extraordinary knowledge, there were very few things that surprised him.

Now, he let out several shocked cries in succession.

“Xue Zhan, did you see anyone?” Liu Qi asked.

Xue Zhan shook his head.

Liu Qi said, “The terrifying lightning struck from a long distance. This person’s strength… is immeasurable!”

Xue Zhan nodded seriously.

“Do you know who he is?” Hu Yixiao asked anxiously. “Quickly tell me!”

“Didn’t I just show you some of his information?” Liu Qi raised his eyelids and said.

“Information?” Hu Yixiao was stunned. “You mean… Lin Fan?”

…

Fu Xuantian, who was leading the special ability team, finally arrived at the border of Jiangbei.

Fu Xuantian sniffed the burnt smell in the air and looked at the stunned warriors with special abilities. He frowned and asked, “What about the beast tide? What happened here?”

Qin Zhong and the other warriors finally came back to their senses.

Therefore, Qin Zhong quickly recounted everything he had seen and heard.

Then, he opened the live recording.

Fu Xuantian looked at the spot where the beast tide had disappeared.

Finally, he looked at the Strength Rankings in the sky and locked his gaze on the words—[First place: Lin Fan.]

“Is it him?” he muttered.

…

What happened at the Jiangbei border was soon spread on the internet.

The heated discussions rose and fell, quickly reaching the top of the trending topics on various social media sites.

Wind, Flower, Snow and Moon: [Why did such scary lightning suddenly fall at the border of Jiangbei?]

Victory: S[o many mutated beasts died in the blink of an eye?]

Tang Song Poet: [F*ck, that’s awesome!]

No Life, No Demon: [Heavenly punishment! This is definitely a terrifying heavenly punishment!]

Big Chest Shield: [What heavenly punishment? Before the lightning struck, a loud sound rang out between heaven and earth. It was really noisy! It’s definitely the work of a special ability user!]

Grass, a Type of Plant: [According to statistics, the number of beasts in the beast tide exceeded 100,000. There are even some people who say that there were S-class mutated beasts! If it was really a special ability user, how strong is that person? They killed countless mutated beasts in one move!]

Snowflake: [Among the top ten people, Lei Sen seems to be the only one with lightning attribute power. But he was still in the boxing gym at that time, so he can be excluded.]

The Person in My Heart: [Who is it?]

Four Seasons of Flowers: Have you all forgotten about the strongest Lin Fan?]

…

When someone mentioned Lin Fan’s name, more and more people started to search for information about him.

Soon, everyone realized that there were close to 100,000 people named Lin Fan.

However, none of them had too much wealth or too much strength.

In fact, hundreds of years ago, there was still no Lin Fan who met the requirements.

Then, someone mentioned the hero of Hua Nation from a thousand years ago—Lin Fan!

Some people were surprised, some sighed, and some were excited. The majority of people did not believe it…

A thousand years was too long.

They did not believe that anyone could live that long.

Furthermore, there were only some words and legends about Lin Fan in this world. There was no video of him at all.

After so many years, many people felt that the hero of a thousand years ago, Lin Fan, was just a legend that was made up by others.

Top physicist, top biologist, top mathematician, top physicist, top computer scientist, top expert… In their hearts, how could there be such a perfect person in this world?

…

Lin Fan did not care about what was happening on the internet or what other people were thinking.

As for exterminating the beast tide, it was just a casual act of his.

Zhang Wenzhuo said, “Lin Fan, do you think the beast tide is about to enter Jiangbei? Can Jiangbei defend against it?”

The Heavenly Hound, who was sitting on the ground, raised its eyelids and looked at him as if it was looking at an idiot.

It was as if it was saying, “You fool, what nonsense are you asking?”

Zhang Wenzhuo seemed to read the words on the Heavenly Hound’s face and said, “Doggo, why are you looking at me?”

Lin Fan smiled. “Don’t worry, we can defend it.”

“Then, will a small number of exotic beasts rush into the city and harm ordinary people?” Zhang Wenzhuo asked again. “Do you think we should help kill the exotic beasts? After all, we’re all special ability users now.”

Speaking of this, Zhang Wenzhuo became nervous and excited.

He had only killed exotic beasts in games.

He had never killed an exotic beast in reality.

There was excitement amidst danger!

Lin Fan smiled. “Probably not.”

Zhang Wenzhuo did not seem to hear Lin Fan’s words and muttered to himself, “No, I have to prepare my battle equipment first. However, isn’t it too late to buy equipment now?”

After saying that, he began to rummage through the dormitory.

Seeing this…

Lin Fan could not help but smile and shake his head. He turned around and lay on the bed in the dormitory that he had not seen for a long time. He closed his eyes and slowly fell asleep.

It had been a long time since he slept in the student dormitory, but it gave him a different kind of comfort.

Tonight, Lin Fan slept very soundly.
